messages:
morgan: FYI rolling kernel-selector v3 yesterday. Seeing a ~25% increase in host CPU on ingress for small streaming requests, mostly parse/tokenize hot path. attaching quick flame summary (short).
lee: ugh, timeframe? service/region? any correlation with burst windows?
morgan: started at ~02:15 UTC. spike shows during grpc/http2 multiplex bursts on host ingress. region: us-west-2. sample flame: `tokenize_utf8` -> `parse_proto_frame` -> `kv_cache_lookup` -> `kernel_selector::evaluate` (hot).
lee: can you paste the flame snippet or pprof link?
morgan: short paste below (sanitized):
```
# top 10
15.2% tokenize_utf8
12.8% parse_proto_frame
9.5% kernel_selector::evaluate
8.0% kv_cache::lookup
6.5% writev_coalesce
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-22T02:10 by @ci-bot (kernel-selector:v3) -> rolled to canary(10%) -> promoted at 02:11
tara: kernel_selector evaluate being on host is new right? v2 used a cheaper heuristic on sidecar. Could be the extra model/seq-length scoring work. Maybe fallback to v2 scoring for small reqs.
ivan: idea: for requests < 128 tokens, short-circuit to lightweight selector (or cache the previous selection per route). avoids calling full `evaluate`. Also check batching heuristics — increased batch churn could invoke selector more often.
morgan: agreed. kv cache misses jumped too (miss rate +12%). suspect kv cache invalidation due to selector switching variant ids.
nina: can we reproduce with loadtest? send me a small script. I can run locally against canary.
morgan: @nina here's a simple curl loop that triggers the path: `for i in {1..2000}; do curl -sS -H "Content-Type: application/grpc" http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d @payload.json; done` payload.json is a short prompt (~50 tokens). Also run `go tool pprof -http=:8081 /tmp/profile` on the ingress binary.
lee: also check if streaming chunking/flush interval changed with the rollout. smallwrite path hits writev and hpack more often, so parse fragmentation is worse.
tara: temporary mitigation: roll back selector to v2 for canary while we triage, or patch selector to memoize by (route, model-arch, quant-profile, shortlen=true).
morgan: starting a canary rollback now. can confirm revert in CI in ~5m.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated at 02:28 by @morgan (kernel-selector:v2) -> canary 10% -> progress ok
ivan: follow-ups: 1) add lightweight selector fastpath for token_count<128 2) add route-level memo cache for selector decisions 3) add telemetry for selector call count per request 4) kv cache keying audit to avoid variant churn
nina: I'll run the loadtest and share pprof links and flame images. expected results: CPU back to baseline if selector is root cause.
morgan: thanks. I'll open a short postmortem draft and include perf diffs and patch plan. assigning to eng-runtime perf triage. :+1:
